theorems.name: Submission.dohr_eb_sch_blowup_holder_estimate
theorems.statement: ∀ n ℓ : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → ∀ α : ℝ, 0 < α → α < 1 → ∀ lam M δ : ℝ, 0 < lam → 0 < δ → ∃ Cδ : ℝ, 0 ≤ Cδ ∧ ∀ (a : Rn n → (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) →L[ℝ] (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) (Φ : Rn n → (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) (w : Rn n → Rn ℓ) (K S G : ℝ), 0 ≤ G → (∀ x ∈ ball (0 : Rn n) 1, ∀ P : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ, lam * ‖P‖ ^ 2 ≤ a x P P) → (∀ x ∈ ball (0 : Rn n) 1, ∀ P Q : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ, |a x P Q| ≤ M * ‖P‖ * ‖Q‖) → (∀ x ∈ ball (0 : Rn n) 1, ∀ y ∈ ball (0 : Rn n) 1, ∀ P Q : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ, |a x P Q - a y P Q| ≤ M * ‖x - y‖ ^ α * ‖P‖ * ‖Q‖) → (∀ x ∈ ball (0 : Rn n) 1, ∀ y ∈ ball (0 : Rn n) 1, ∀ P : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ, |Φ x P - Φ y P| ≤ G * ‖x - y‖ ^ α * ‖P‖) → (∀ x ∈ ball (0 : Rn n) 1, ‖w x‖ ≤ S) → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 w (ball (0 : Rn n) 1) → (∀ x ∈ ball (0 : Rn n) 1, ∀ y ∈ ball (0 : Rn n) 1, ‖fderiv ℝ w x - fderiv ℝ w y‖ ≤ K * ‖x - y‖ ^ α) → (∀ ζ : Rn n → Rn ℓ, ContDiff ℝ 1 ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ ball (0 : Rn n) 1 → ∫ x in ball (0 : Rn n) 1, a x (fderiv ℝ w x) (fderiv ℝ ζ x) = ∫ x in ball (0 : Rn n) 1, Φ x (fderiv ℝ ζ x)) → ∀ x ∈ ball (0 : Rn n) (1 / 2), ∀ y ∈ ball (0 : Rn n) (1 / 2), ‖fderiv ℝ w x - fderiv ℝ w y‖ ≤ (δ * K + Cδ * (S + G)) * ‖x - y‖ ^ α
